1: """Sparse-polynomial principal BV algebra, no IO and no fitted tensor ansatz.
2: 
3: q0..q3 are loop/direction variables; a,b,c parametrize p=a e0,r=b e0+c e1.
4: Fiber sums are contracted by Itr on symmetric tensors, independently of the
5: ten-coordinate contraction in marked_vertex_engine.
6: """
7: from fractions import Fraction
8: from sympy.polys.rings import ring
9: from sympy.polys.domains import QQ
10: 
11: R,*VARS=ring('q0,q1,q2,q3,a,b,c',QQ)
12: q=VARS[:4];a,b,c=VARS[4:]
13: ZERO=R.zero;ONE=R.one
14: I=[[ONE if i==j else ZERO for j in range(4)] for i in range(4)]
15: axes=[[ONE if i==j else ZERO for j in range(4)] for i in range(4)]
16: P=[a,ZERO,ZERO,ZERO];Q=[b,c,ZERO,ZERO]
17: def add(x,y):return [u+v for u,v in zip(x,y)]
18: def scale(x,t):return [v*t for v in x]
19: def dot(x,y):return sum((u*v for u,v in zip(x,y)),ZERO)
20: def trace(H):return sum((H[i][i] for i in range(4)),ZERO)
21: def madd(A,B):return [[A[i][j]+B[i][j] for j in range(4)] for i in range(4)]
22: def mscale(A,t):return [[v*t for v in row] for row in A]
23: def inner(A,B):return sum((A[i][j]*B[i][j] for i in range(4) for j in range(4)),ZERO)
24: def mv(H,v):return [dot(row,v) for row in H]
25: def outer(x,y):return [[u*v for v in y] for u in x]
26: def sym(x,y):return mscale(madd(outer(x,y),outer(y,x)),QQ(1,2))
27: def itr(H):return madd(H,mscale(I,-trace(H)/2))
28: def gauge(k,u):return madd(outer(k,u),outer(u,k))
29: def lie(H,p,k,u):return madd(mscale(H,dot(p,u)),gauge(k,mv(H,u)))
30: def C(H,p):return add(mv(H,p),scale(p,-trace(H)/2))
31: def bracket(p,v,r,w):return add(scale(w,dot(v,r)),scale(v,-dot(w,p)))
32: def R0(p,v):
33:     return madd(mscale(gauge(p,v),-QQ(3,8)*dot(p,p)),mscale(outer(p,p),dot(p,v)/2))
34: def source_duals(T,k,l):
35:     t=mv(T,l)
36:     return [madd(mscale(T,k[m]),gauge(axes[m],t)) for m in range(4)]
37: def ghost_duals(k,l,v):
38:     """B_n with tr(B_n H)=[V(H,k,l)v]_n, independent index derivation."""
39:     r=add(k,l);kv=dot(k,v);rl=dot(r,l)
40:     result=[]
41:     for n in range(4):
42:         B=madd(mscale(sym(axes[n],r),kv),mscale(sym(axes[n],v),rl))
43:         B=madd(B,mscale(sym(v,r),l[n]))
44:         B=madd(B,mscale(I,-r[n]*kv/2))
45:         B=madd(B,mscale(sym(v,l),-r[n]))
46:         result.append(mscale(B,-1))
47:     return result
48: def ghost_matrix(H,k,l):
49:     cols=[list(map(lambda B:inner(B,H),ghost_duals(k,l,e))) for e in axes]
50:     return [[cols[j][i] for j in range(4)] for i in range(4)]
51: def eh2(A,B,p):return dot(p,p)*inner(A,itr(B))-2*dot(C(A,p),C(B,p))
52: def cubic_gauge(A,pa,B,pb,k,v):
53:     """16kappa V3(K_k v,A,B) from classical diffeomorphism Ward identity."""
54:     return -4*(eh2(lie(A,pa,k,v),B,pb)+eh2(A,lie(B,pb,k,v),pa))
55: 
56: def marked_numerators(T,k,u,r,v):
57:     """h*(T,-k-r), metric(K_k u,k), ghost(v,r)."""
58:     l=add(add(k,r),scale(q,-1))
59:     us=[itr(A) for A in source_duals(T,q,l)]
60:     ghostvertex=ghost_matrix(gauge(k,u),k,add(r,scale(q,-1)))
61:     end=ghost_duals(scale(q,-1),r,v)
62:     ng=sum((ghostvertex[m][n]*inner(us[m],end[n]) for m in range(4) for n in range(4)),ZERO)
63:     other=[itr(B) for B in ghost_duals(add(k,scale(q,-1)),r,v)]
64:     nm=sum((cubic_gauge(us[m],scale(q,-1),other[m],add(q,scale(k,-1)),k,u)
65:             for m in range(4)),ZERO)
66:     return ng,nm
67: 
68: def triangle_numerator(T,p,v,r,w):
69:     Y=scale(mv(T,add(p,r)),2);k=add(q,p);l=add(r,scale(q,-1))
70:     aa=ghost_duals(q,p,v);bb=ghost_duals(scale(q,-1),r,w)
71:     def contract(ds,x):
72:         return [[sum((x[m]*ds[m][i][j] for m in range(4)),ZERO) for j in range(4)] for i in range(4)]
73:     return inner(itr(contract(aa,l)),contract(bb,Y))-inner(itr(contract(aa,Y)),contract(bb,k))
74: 
75: def angular(exps):
76:     if any(x%2 for x in exps):return QQ.zero
77:     out=Fraction(1)
78:     for x in exps:
79:         for f in range(1,x,2):out*=f
80:     for j in range(sum(exps)//2):out/=4+2*j
81:     return QQ(out.numerator,out.denominator)
82: 
83: class UV:
84:     def __init__(self,shifts,maximum=4):
85:         self.m=len(shifts);self.product=[ONE]+[ZERO]*maximum
86:         for shift in shifts:
87:             u=2*dot(q,shift);v=dot(shift,shift);den=[ONE]
88:             for j in range(1,maximum+1):den.append(-u*den[j-1]-(v*den[j-2] if j>=2 else ZERO))
89:             self.product=[sum((self.product[i]*den[j-i] for i in range(j+1)),ZERO)
90:                           for j in range(maximum+1)]
91:     def extract(self,num):
92:         grouped={}
93:         for exps,coef in num.items():
94:             order=sum(exps[:4])+4-2*self.m
95:             if order>=0:
96:                 assert order<len(self.product)
97:                 grouped.setdefault(order,{})[exps]=coef
98:         radial=sum((R.from_dict(terms)*self.product[order] for order,terms in grouped.items()),ZERO)
99:         out={}
100:         for exps,coef in radial.items():
101:             av=angular(exps[:4])
102:             if av:
103:                 key=(0,0,0,0)+exps[4:]
104:                 out[key]=out.get(key,QQ.zero)+coef*av
105:         return R.from_dict({k:v for k,v in out.items() if v})
106: 
107: ZERO4=[ZERO]*4
108: UVLG=UV([ZERO4,scale(P,-1),scale(add(P,Q),-1)])
109: UVLM=UV([ZERO4,scale(Q,-1),scale(add(P,Q),-1)])
110: UVRG=UVLM
111: UVRM=UVLG
112: UVTRI=UV([ZERO4,P,scale(Q,-1)])
113: 
114: def ward(T,v,w):
115:     ln,lmn=marked_numerators(T,Q,w,P,v)
116:     rn,rmn=marked_numerators(T,P,v,Q,w)
117:     lg,lm=UVLG.extract(ln),UVLM.extract(lmn)
118:     rg,rm=UVRG.extract(rn),UVRM.extract(rmn)
119:     tri=UVTRI.extract(triangle_numerator(T,P,v,Q,w))
120:     free=inner(T,madd(madd(R0(add(P,Q),bracket(P,v,Q,w)),
121:                     mscale(lie(R0(Q,w),Q,P,v),-1)),lie(R0(P,v),P,Q,w)))
122:     return tri+free-lg+lm/4+rg-rm/4,(tri,free,lg,lm,rg,rm)
